aka.zh: 史迪威公路（昆明至保山）

tagline.en: From People's Square in Shanghai to the Burmese border at Ruili, ending on the Burma Road of 1938
tagline.zh: 从上海人民广场到中缅边境瑞丽，西段就是 1938 年的滇缅公路

start.en: Jiegao, Ruili, on the Burmese border, Yunnan
start.zh: 云南瑞丽市姐告（中缅边境）

en: G320 runs 3,695 km from People's Square in Shanghai to Jiegao in Ruili on the Burmese border, through Shanghai, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guizhou and Yunnan. It leaves the Yangtze delta through Jiaxing and Hangzhou, runs up the Fuchun and Xin'an valleys into Jiangxi, passes Nanchang and crosses Hunan to Guizhou, then climbs on to the Yunnan plateau to Kunming and runs west through Dali and Baoshan to the border.

West of Kunming it is the Burma Road, and Kunming to Baoshan was also part of the wartime Stilwell Road. Between the Yunnan–Guizhou border and Kunming the national road now shares the G60 expressway; the old road there became provincial road S101. The atlas draws the route in two pieces, a long one through Yunnan, Guizhou, Hunan, Jiangxi and Zhejiang to Shanghai and a shorter one in Hunan; this profile is attached to the long piece.
zh: G320 自上海人民广场至中缅边境的瑞丽姐告，全长 3695 公里，途经上海、浙江、江西、湖南、贵州、云南六省市。它经嘉兴、杭州离开长江三角洲，沿富春江、新安江谷地进入江西，经南昌横穿湖南到贵州，再登上云南高原到昆明，向西经大理、保山抵达边境。
昆明以西就是滇缅公路，昆明至保山段也是抗战时期史迪威公路的一部分。贵州云南交界至昆明段，国道现与 G60 高速公路共线，原有老路改为省道 S101。本图集将路线绘为两段：较长一段经云南、贵州、湖南、江西、浙江到上海，另一段较短，在湖南境内；本条目挂在较长一段上。

en: The best-known piece of engineering on the route is the 24 bends at Qinglong in Guizhou, at about km 2337: some 4 km of road climbing a slope of about 60 degrees in 24 hairpins, 350 m across and 250 m high. It was surveyed from August 1935 by the engineer Zou Yuesheng of Funing, Jiangsu, and the Guizhou section of the road opened in September 1936. In 1954 a 6 km loop, the 'Moon retaining wall', replaced the climb on the main road; the bends became a national key heritage site in 2006.

The Burma Road itself was built almost entirely by hand. According to the Yunnan foreign affairs office it moved 19.98 million cubic metres of earth and 1.875 million cubic metres of rock and built 536 bridges. In the east the road is being rebuilt to modern standards: a 31.6 km section in Tongxiang between Fengming and Dama opened on 1 November 2023, and in Jiande a 62.51 km section between Yangcunqiao and Huizeli was approved on 28 January 2022.
zh: 全线最有名的工程是贵州晴隆的“二十四道拐”，位于约 2337 公里处：约 4 公里的公路以 24 道弯爬上约 60 度的山坡，水平距离 350 米、垂直高度 250 米。1935 年 8 月起由江苏阜宁籍工程师邹岳生勘测，公路贵州段 1936 年 9 月通车。1954 年，一段 6 公里长的“月亮岩挡墙”回头线取代了这段爬坡，成为主线；二十四道拐 2006 年被列为全国重点文物保护单位。
滇缅公路本身几乎全靠人力修成。据云南省外办，工程量为土方 1998 万立方米、石方 187.5 万立方米，建桥 536 座。东段正按现代标准改建：桐乡凤鸣至大麻段 31.6 公里 2023 年 11 月 1 日通车；建德杨村桥至徽泽里段 62.51 公里 2022 年 1 月 28 日获批。

en: The Burma Road was planned in August 1937, after Japan's invasion of China, when the Yunnan governor Long Yun proposed a road to the sea through Burma. Kunming–Xiaguan, 411.6 km, had already opened in December 1935; the new 547.8 km from Xiaguan to Wanding was begun at the end of 1937 (People's Daily dates it to January 1938) by a workforce that reached more than 200,000, mostly old men, women and children. The road opened on 31 August 1938, 959.4 km in about nine months, and The Times compared it with the Panama Canal. More than 3,000 workers died building it; between 1939 and 1942 it carried more than 500,000 tonnes of supplies.

The road through Guizhou had a longer start: the 24 bends were begun in 1927, merchants paid for work in 1931, and central funds came in June 1935. In 1945 the road from Kunming was renamed the Stilwell Road after the Ledo road joined it. After 1949 it was rebuilt repeatedly — in Guizhou in 1954, 1959 and 1965, asphalted in the 1970s and upgraded to the national GBM standard in the late 1980s — and it was numbered G320. The present eastern rebuilds date from the 2020s.
zh: 滇缅公路规划于 1937 年 8 月日本全面侵华之后，云南省主席龙云提出修一条经缅甸通往海洋的公路。昆明至下关 411.6 公里已于 1935 年 12 月通车；新修的下关至畹町段 547.8 公里于 1937 年底动工（人民网称 1938 年 1 月），民工最多时 20 余万，大多是老人、妇女和儿童。公路于 1938 年 8 月 31 日通车，959.4 公里用时约九个月，英国《泰晤士报》把它比作巴拿马运河。修路牺牲的民工超过 3000 人；1939 年至 1942 年，它运送了 50 余万吨物资。
贵州段起步更早：二十四道拐 1927 年开修，1931 年商人出资续修，1935 年 6 月获中央拨款。1945 年，雷多公路接通后，昆明起的这条公路更名为史迪威公路。1949 年后屡经改建——贵州段 1954、1959、1965 年改建，20 世纪 70 年代铺沥青，80 年代后期按国道 GBM 标准改造——并定为 320 国道。东段的新一轮改建始于 2020 年代。

en: No cost exists for the whole route. For the Burma Road, Xinhua gives more than 2 million yuan for the section built by Tengchong county alone, where more than 2,000 of 50,000 workers died. The modern rebuilds are priced separately: the Tongxiang Fengming–Dama section, 31.6 km, cost 3.747 billion yuan as a public–private partnership; the Jiande Yangcunqiao–Huizeli section, 62.51 km, was approved at 7.765 billion yuan; and the Gao'an realignment in Jiangxi, 27.45 km, is reported at 1.771 billion yuan by a construction trade site, a figure not checked against an official one.
zh: 全线没有总造价。滇缅公路方面，新华社记载仅腾冲县承修路段就耗资 200 余万元，5 万民工中 2000 余人牺牲。现代改建各段分别计价：桐乡凤鸣至大麻段 31.6 公里，采用 PPP 模式，投资 37.47 亿元；建德杨村桥至徽泽里段 62.51 公里，批复投资 77.65 亿元；江西高安改线 27.45 公里，据建筑行业网站投资 17.71 亿元，该数字未与官方资料核对。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole route, which joins the Burma Road of 1938 to roads of other periods and is now rebuilt section by section, each priced separately. See the section figures below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：路线把 1938 年的滇缅公路与其他时期的道路连在一起，如今分段改建、分段计价。见下方各段数字。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement exists. The Burma Road was built by Yunnan's counties with conscripted labour; modern sections are funded locally, the Tongxiang section as a public–private partnership and the Jiaxing Jiantao–Puyuangang section from public funds.
why.zh: 未见全线出资说明。滇缅公路由云南各县征工修建；现代各段由地方出资，桐乡段采用 PPP 模式，嘉兴尖桃至濮院港段使用财政资金。

timeline.en: Work begins on the 24 bends road at Qinglong.
timeline.zh: 晴隆二十四道拐公路开修。

timeline.en: Kunming–Xiaguan opens in December; the 24 bends are surveyed from August.
timeline.zh: 8 月起勘测二十四道拐；12 月，昆明至下关公路通车。

timeline.en: The Guizhou section, with the 24 bends, opens in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，含二十四道拐的贵州段通车。

timeline.en: The Burma Road opens on 31 August after about nine months' work.
timeline.zh: 8 月 31 日，滇缅公路经约九个月施工通车。

timeline.en: The road from Kunming is renamed the Stilwell Road.
timeline.zh: 昆明起的公路更名为史迪威公路。

timeline.en: The 'Moon retaining wall' loop replaces the 24 bends on the main road.
timeline.zh: “月亮岩挡墙”回头线取代二十四道拐成为主线。

timeline.en: The 24 bends become a national key heritage site.
timeline.zh: 二十四道拐列为全国重点文物保护单位。

timeline.en: The Jiande Yangcunqiao–Huizeli rebuild is approved on 28 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 28 日，建德杨村桥至徽泽里段获批。

timeline.en: The Tongxiang Fengming–Dama section opens on 1 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 1 日，桐乡凤鸣至大麻段通车。
